'''Corpse''' is a game system in ''[[Graveyard Keeper 2]]''. They are obtained from [[Donkey]].

== Autopsies ==
A corpse can be placed on an [[Autopsy Table]] in the [[morgue]]. From there, the corpse's {{Skull|Red}} and {{Skull|White}}, body parts, and other parts can be viewed if the corresponding [[Technologies|technology]] has been unlocked.

A corpse left on the ground for to long turns into a pile of ash that needs to be cleaned up by the keeper. Piles of ash produces nothing when cleaned up, The piles of ash no longer count towards the [[Morgue|Morgue's]] corpse totals.

* {{Skull|White}} determines the maximum [[File:Graveyard Quality.png|20px|link=Graveyard]] in the [[graveyard]].
* {{Skull|Red}} determines the maxium
